content:
maria: CI job 'build-and-push' red on main, started ~08:05 UTC. failing at docker push with 'denied: requested access to the resource is denied' and some layer EOF errors. anyone seen this before?

aj: can you paste the push log? is this on GH Actions or our internal runners?

maria: GH Actions, runner 'hosted-linux-x64'. here's the tail:

```
Pushing to registry.redwood-inference.internal/repo/service:main
error: failed to push some refs to 'registry.redwood-inference.internal/repo/service'
denied: requested access to the resource is denied
writing layer sha256:abc123...: unexpected EOF
```

sam: two likely things: (1) registry creds/token expired or wrong, (2) partial layer upload/corrupt cache on the runner. we recently rotated tokens?

ops-team: we rotated the registry service token at 07:58 UTC as part of routine rotation. ops was supposed to update the "REGISTRY_TOKEN" secret in the org vault but that didn't get propagated to the GH org secret due to an automation hiccup. I'm on it. ETA ~10m.

aj: if token rotation is the cause then pull will fail with denied. but unexpected EOF for a layer smells like a flaky network or cached layer mismatch. try forcing a fresh build (no cache + pull).

maria: trying a manual rerun with `--no-cache --pull` in the build step now. also adding explicit docker login step using the temporary token once ops gives it.

ci-bot: note: workflow 'build-and-push (main)' run 312 re-run requested by maria. queued.

sam: other quick mitigation: change the build job to `docker build --pull --no-cache -t ...` and disable actions/cache for docker layers for that run. if that fixes it, we can keep cache disabled for a few runs and then re-enable.

maria: ops updated the secret in vault and pushed to GH org secrets at 08:20 UTC. rerun started.

aj: if push still fails after token update, try increasing the upload chunk size / set DOCKER_UPLOAD_CHUNK_SIZE env to 1048576 in the step, sometimes helps with EOF on flaky runners. also check runner disk space; EOF can happen when disk fills mid-upload.

maria: good call — runner disk was at 92% in the job log. cleaning old images on that runner for subsequent runs. current rerun shows login success but still hitting EOF on one layer, switching to a fresh runner now.

ops-team: confirmed: the automation fix is in place to propagate future rotations. will post change-id in infra PR.

maria: new run on a fresh hosted runner succeeded with `--no-cache --pull`. pushing a follow-up PR to workflow to add `--pull --no-cache` and bump build-push-action to v4.0. Also adding a short note to release checklist to coordinate token rotations.

aj: awesome. Marking this as triaged. follow-up: add healthcheck to fail fast on runner disk >85% and a small job to validate registry secrets after rotations.

maria: adding both to TODOs. thanks all :thumbsup:
